items.sentence: A typical park version has a horizontal plank supported by two or more sturdy legs.
Some designs include a backrest and armrests, while others leave the sitting surface unobstructed.
Outdoor models often use weather-resistant timber, metal, stone, or molded plastic for their frame and surface.
The sitting platform is usually broad enough to accommodate several people side by side.
People settle onto the rigid platform, which distributes their weight across its supporting legs.
When moved, lightweight versions can be lifted from underneath by people gripping opposite ends.
In public settings, people often sit temporarily while waiting, resting, or speaking with companions.
Maintenance workers tighten loose fasteners and refinish exposed wood to keep the structure serviceable.
A long seat may stand beside a walking path where visitors pause amid a park or garden.
A train station waiting area may contain a long seat for passengers between departures.
Schools place these seats in corridors or outdoor courtyards where students gather between classes.
In locker rooms, a simple low seat provides a place to pause near changing areas.
It offers shared seating in locations where individual chairs would take up more floor space.
A memorial version gives visitors a place to sit while reflecting at a commemorative site.
Along a dining table, a backless long seat lets several diners sit close together.
In a courtroom or place of worship, fixed rows provide orderly seating for groups.
